exceptions.reason: Temporary exception: NOLINE does not pass user-controlled brace patterns to braces. Runtime Daytona usage is limited to Sandbox operations and does not call Image.extractCopySources; Tailwind and ESLint paths execute only during trusted build/development workflows.
exceptions.exposureAnalysis: HTTP, NOVA, Agent Builder, uploads and Forge mission inputs do not invoke braces. Forge search_code executes rg with normalized literal terms, bounded paths and extensions. Repository filenames/content remain data handled inside the sandbox and are not passed to the Daytona SDK Image Dockerfile glob helper.
exceptions.upstreamStatus: GitHub Advisory reports no patched version as of approval.
exceptions.removalCondition: Remove immediately when a compatible patched braces release is available, update dependencies and lockfile, and restore zero accepted advisories.
